subject: MdeModulePkg/DisplayEngineDxe: fix gcc 16 warning
reasons: The change is confined to one function in one C file.
It removes an unused local and deletes a now-unneeded loop counter increment, which is a one-off warning cleanup rather than a reusable structural transformation.
There is no repetition across files or multiple call sites, so there is no scale for a Coccinelle rule to leverage.
